Sakura isn't speaking to me.

She is rejecting herself.

The person she has become.

Half-mad, she pours all her hatred upon the self drenched in Tohsaka's blood, the self stained black, and the dark shadow connected to her.

Sakura’s voice isn’t directed at me.
She’s rejecting everything.
Her own body, covered in Tohsaka’s blood, her darkened self, the pillar connected to her.
She’s cursing everything with all her might.

Sakura is being torn apart between the guilt driving her to suicide and the shadow that refuses to let her die.

If I hadn't been afraid when the shadow consumed her—if I had simply smacked her on the head—none of this would have happened.
